date.as_written: śāke 1765 bhādrapadamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ tithau bhaumavāsare

notes: The catalogue lists 'śrīkṛṣṇadevaprasāda' as the scribe, but the text reads 'likhitamidaṃ gītāsārabhāṣā śrīkṛṣṇadeva prasādeva pāpasaṃcayaṃ harati' (i.e. śrīkṛṣṇadeva-prasāda eva pāpasaṃcayaṃ harati, 'the grace of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa alone destroys the heap of sins'). This is a devotional phrase rather than a personal name, so no human scribe or other person is named in the colophon.
